selection_rule: Among the ten reconstructed SSL-GGL checkpoints, sort by descending capture_area_10_percent, then descending success_rate_curve_auc_reconstructed; deterministic tie-break by repeat ascending.

original_experiment_best.note: Original fine-tuned checkpoint was not saved; this model was not available for the new IG analysis.

score_recomputation_check.tolerance: AUC difference <= 1e-5 and exact equality of capture at 10% area
score_recomputation_check.note: CUDA attention backend can alter near-saturated float outputs slightly; the rank TIFF uses the exact saved scores for the selected run.

original_run_note: The original fine-tuned weights were not saved. This analysis uses the selected reconstructed checkpoint and its matching reconstructed-run metrics; it is not the original run's exact model weights.

primary_legacy_per_anchor_ig.scope: 556 anchors in the union of the four target polygons, each explained by its own prospectivity logit
primary_legacy_per_anchor_ig.hard_constraints: held at their observed deterministic values; no attribution computed for these channels

current_model_gnnexplainer.hard_constraints: fixed at observed values and not attributed
